title: EMPIRE: Explicit Manipulation Planning as a Learnable Intermediate Representation for Egocentric Hand-Motion Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2608.22449v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Forecasting dexterous hand motions from egocentric observations is fundamental to intelligent interactive systems. Existing VLM-based methods typically map observations directly to future motions, overlooking the underlying manipulation process that governs hand-object interactions. Moreover, end-to-end optimization couples manipulation learning with motion synthesis, causing motion-generation gradients to interfere with the pre-learned manipulation-aware representations. To overcome these limitations, we propose EMPIRE, a two-stage framework that introduces Explicit Manipulation Planning as an Intermediate Representation for Egocentric hand-motion forecasting. translated_title: EMPIRE：将显式操作规划作为可学习的中间表示用于自我中心手部运动预测
translated_abstract: 摘要：从自我中心观察预测灵巧手部运动是智能交互系统的基础。现有的基于VLM的方法通常直接将观察映射到未来运动，忽略了控制手物交互的潜在操作过程。此外，端到端优化将操作学习与运动合成耦合在一起，导致运动生成梯度干扰预先学习的操作感知表示。为克服这些限制，我们提出EMPIRE，一种两阶段框架，引入显式操作规划作为自我中心手部运动预测的中间表示。第一阶段：学习规划。EMPIRE首先从多模态上下文中学习显式操作规划，以捕捉手物交互的进展。第二阶段：学习行动。运动生成器基于冻结的规划器表示合成未来的双手手部运动。
tldr: 提出EMPIRE两阶段框架，通过显式操作规划作为中间表示，解耦操作学习与运动合成，从而提升自我中心手部运动预测的准确性。
en_tdlr: EMPIRE proposes a two-stage framework that uses explicit manipulation planning as an intermediate representation to decouple manipulation learning from motion synthesis, improving egocentric hand-motion forecasting.
